state: Static decode/export only; no Java, tests, native execution/emulation, game or media playback.
noDoubleMotion: Existing combat_counter and combat_barrage pose rows have zero horizontal translations on all bones. Their vertical sole correction already subtracts Motion_Root height; do not add source Y or change those poses.
axis: Existing retarget reflects source X to model -X; renderer rotates model by180-yaw. Combined root mapping is(dx,0,-dz).yRot(-yaw). All sampled native Motion_Root rotations are identity.
timing: Counter sourceFrame=min42,age*1.5*.9; release starts at legacy composed age8/sourceFrame3, then min76,3+(age-8)*1.5. Subtract within each clip; absolute root coordinates are unrelated authoring offsets. No interpolation between counter endZ-6.516 and release startZ+.267.

implementation.scope: HunterCounterMotion supplies COUNTER and only COUNTER_RELEASE-marked BARRAGE. Standalone barrage and other actions retain their existing movement. No synchronized fields added; server actual entity position uses normal entity replication.
implementation.collision: Each observed phase delta goes through Entity.move SELF using actual block/entity collision shapes and existing step-up behavior. Entire requested swept AABB must stay in loaded chunks and world border; the requested root must remain in mob restriction. Invalid boundaries cancel the chain. After horizontal-only move, formerly-grounded actor retains onGround only if its accepted bbox shifted .01 downward intersects real collision support.
implementation.blocked: No desired world endpoint is retained. Animation age advances even when collision rejects part/all travel, and the next difference starts at the actual accepted entity position. Removing cover cannot repay previous blocked distance.
implementation.continuity: Same age is ignored. A gap over1tick or displacement over8blocks cancels rather than replaying an unobserved movement/hit corridor. This is an explicit MC safety policy, not a decoded source teleport limit.
implementation.lifecycle: Counter release rebases its root at the accepted counter endpoint. cancel/claim/NoAI/stun/load clear transient continuation; same-object NBT load also cancels. attackEpoch invalidates movement/damage callback reentry before stale tick writes or another hit window. Active attacks are not saved/resumed.
implementation.reach: AI opening/release previews include the same future source offsets; they only allow selection. Actual damage still requires the posed wrist sweep at accepted actor positions, existing LOS and accepted hurt.
implementation.pendingTests: HunterCounterTest5 methods including8 independent source-root fixtures and no-double-horizontal-pose check; HunterCounterGameTest8 methods including real two-stage movement/duplicate tick, full-height wall/no movement repayment, same-object load.

limits: No Java/Gradle/unit/GameTest/game/native execution or emulation/media playback performed.

Full native root-motion blend/controller/physics execution is not reproduced: these are original translation deltas applied to the existing MC locomotion and collision adapter. Existing pose joins are retained; no inferred root velocity blending is added.
Existing authored rigid skeleton, sole-height correction and action timing remain. Source large hit impulse, complete reaction-counter AI and original skinned body are still separate gaps.

Existing counter pose exporter ignores child Spine_1/Spine_2/Neck SCL tracks (ranges recorded above). Motion_Root is independent bone0 with only translation, so root travel is unaffected; full counter skin scaling is not claimed complete.
Actual client interpolation, uneven ground, stairs, crowd collision and combat around cover require later permitted player acceptance.
